default/32575.htm.text: Teleporter Light of Dawn: You hear what sounds like a human voice emanating from the shining blue sphere. "I am the light of Dawn. Those who seek entry to the Sanctum must first seek authorization, and have specific documents on their person. Do you wish to gain access?"
